description: A pass-local adapter weight override on a model whose adapters fold irreversibly into its dense weights at load. Nearly every family is in that position, so `perPassAdapters` defaults FALSE on the descriptor and the shared floor rejects the override rather than accepting and ignoring it — accepting it would render the wrong image and report success. An EMPTY adapters list is not an override (it means the load-time stack at its load-time scales) and stays legal everywhere. This is a CAPABILITY gap (typed Error::Unsupported), not a range error.
